title: Tötungsdelikt am Humboldt Forum – letzter Tatverdächtiger festgenommen

extraction.summaryEn: A 20-year-old man died after a brawl between two groups at the Humboldt Forum on the evening of 12 September 2025. The 6th Homicide Commission has arrested suspects, including a 16-year-old taken into custody at Gesundbrunnen station.
